name: int64_min_via_json_bridge
description: int64 minimum (-2^63) presented as a bare-integer JSON literal is ingested through the JSON->value bridge into an exact int64 and emitted as plain decimal digits, not exponent notation. This is the asymmetric-interval edge on the render side: an encoder that gates plain-decimal on a magnitude (abs < 2^63) rather than the closed interval [-2^63, 2^63-1] would wrongly render -2^63 in exponent form (SPEC 2.3.1, 2.3.2).
